title: Schylling NeeDoh Original - Sensory Fidget Toy - Pink - Ages 3 to Adult , 1 Count ( Pack of 1)

reviews.title: One of my favorites
reviews.body: I’ve gotten this ball for Christmas for the past 3 years and it’s one of my favorite things to have. Very fun the throw around with friends or myself. They do however break fairly easy. After a week or two of throwing around a squeezing, a little rip may appear. But I do throw it around A LOT, so it can take a fair bit of use. If one breaks, I’ll buy another, because how awesome they are.Side note: if you use it a lot and wash it a couple times and then dry it, the ball will start to become sticky and you can throw it on the ceiling and get it stuck (I do this when I’m bored and watch it fall back down)
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 22, 2024
reviews.author: Isaac

reviews.title: Groovy glob Needoh!
reviews.body: This Groovy glob Needoh is the perfect example of a good sensory toy! Its texture is perfect with both smooth and soft textures! Its size is a little bit smaller than the gumdrop Needoh! Overall it’s really fun to play with!! Definitely worth $8 and will buy again!!

reviews.title: Schylling NeeDoh Original - Sensory Fidget Toy
reviews.body: A Must-Have for Stress Relief and Focus!"The Schylling NeeDoh Original has quickly become one of my favorite go-to fidget toys for stress relief and maintaining focus. From the moment I first held it, I knew it was something special. The texture is incredibly soft, squishy, and just the right amount of resistance when you squeeze it. It’s super satisfying to squish, stretch, and mold in your hands—instantly calming, like a little pocket-sized stress reliever.The best part? It’s durable! I’ve been using mine for weeks, and it still feels as good as new, with no signs of wear or tear. It doesn't leak or leave any residue on my hands, which is a huge bonus because I can use it without worrying about any mess. The compact size makes it easy to take with me anywhere, whether I’m at work, in a meeting, or even just sitting at home relaxing. It’s also perfect for kids and adults alike, offering a great way to relieve tension and anxiety without being disruptive.As someone who works long hours at a desk, I find it incredibly helpful during stressful moments or when I need a mental break. It helps me stay focused during tasks and even boosts my productivity. Plus, it’s fun! It’s such a simple concept, but the joy of squeezing and squishing it never gets old.I’ve also noticed that it’s been a hit with friends and family who’ve tried it. It’s ideal for all ages, and even my younger nieces and nephews love playing with it when they visit. I’ve even caught myself using it while watching TV or reading—it’s just that addictive!If you're someone who needs a little help managing stress, anxiety, or simply needs a sensory outlet to keep your hands busy, this is a must-have. The Schylling NeeDoh is versatile, fun, and incredibly soothing. I can’t recommend it enough!"
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 19, 2024
reviews.author: Benjamin

reviews.title: Beware: These balls stink - they are made out of Thermoplastic Rubber (TPR)
reviews.body: I should have looked at the material these kind of Needoh balls are made out of which is Thermoplastic Rubber (TPR) which stinks awfully and feels very sticky, not really fun in the hands.I prefer silicone. I like their Needoh cubes better. Won't buy again. No thank you to Thermoplastic Rubber (TPR).

reviews.title: Watch out with kids
reviews.body: Be careful with these around small kids. It’s easy to pop and has a weird shaving cream like substance in them. Even with larger kids they can easily pop it and then they will want to color on your walls with this weird chemical substance. Based on a true story

features: The groovy Glob of gratifying goo, this ultimate stress ball will help you mellow out and find inner Peace, tranquility and calm mindfulness
Feeling stressed and on edge? You knead Nee Doh. Give it a squeeze, a squish, a pull or a smush, it'll sooth your soul and get you feeling groovy fast
Filled with a mysterious, completely non-toxic, jelly-like compound, it's strong, durable and won't break open; always returns to its original shape
Hypoallergenic and completely safe, It contains no BPA, phthalates or latex; cleans easily with soap and water
A great fidget toy; appropriate for those with add, ADHD, ocd, Autism and anxiety; helps promote focus, attention and centering, for ages 3+
